<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>WigWam Profit Share</title>
<style>
:root{--orange:#f28c28;--deep:#9e4e12;--ink:#34251b;--muted:#8b7869;--cream:#fff8f0;--pale:#fff0e2;--line:#f0d4ba;--green:#25845b}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f6f2ee;color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif}
header{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#9e4e12,#f28c28);color:white;padding:22px max(20px,calc((100% - 1080px)/2));}.brand-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}.brand-logo{display:block;width:min(260px,48vw);height:auto;max-height:150px;object-fit:contain}.brand-header h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,34px)}
header h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,34px)}header p{margin:5px 0 0;opacity:.9}
main{max-width:1080px;margin:24px auto;padding:0 18px 40px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(280px,.8fr);gap:18px}
.card{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #4a30200b}
h2{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 14px}.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}label{font-size:12px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
input{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--cream);min-width:0}
input:focus,select:focus{outline:2px solid #f6bd82;border-color:var(--orange)}
.profitbox{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.metric{background:var(--pale);padding:14px;border-radius:12px}.metric small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}.metric strong{font-size:23px;color:var(--deep)}
.person{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,1fr) 120px 36px;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:8px 0}
button{border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 15px;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer;background:var(--orange);color:white}
button:hover{filter:brightness(.96)}button.secondary{background:var(--pale);color:var(--deep)}button.remove{padding:8px;background:#fff1ed;color:#b34b31}
.actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.results{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.result{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px}.resulttop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.amount{font-weight:800;color:var(--deep)}.bar{height:7px;background:#f3eee9;border-radius:20px;margin-top:9px;overflow:hidden}.bar span{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--orange)}
.directory{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}.directory-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;font-size:13px}.directory-actions{display:flex;gap:5px}.directory-actions button{padding:6px 9px;font-size:12px}.directory-actions .remove{padding:6px 9px}.notice{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 0}.status{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.status.ok{background:#edf8f1;color:var(--green)}.status.err{background:#fff1ed;color:#a43e29}
.full{grid-column:1/-1}.hidden{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){main{grid-template-columns:1fr}.full{grid-column:auto}.person{grid-template-columns:minmax(80px,1fr) 95px 34px}.profitbox{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="brand-header">
  <img class="brand-logo" src="data:image/webp;base64,
